data.name: DM0101
data.value: MCP tool structured content not allowed for this return type

data.name: DM0101_Message
data.value: Method '{0}' returns '{1}', which cannot produce structured content. Remove 'Structured = true' from the McpServerTool attribute.

data.name: DM0101_Description
data.value: The return type cannot generate a valid outputSchema (must be type 'object'). Structured = true is only valid for non-nullable object types that can be serialized as JSON objects.

data.name: DM0102
data.value: MCP tool requires explicit Structured setting for nullable or collection return types

data.name: DM0102_Message
data.value: Method '{0}' returns '{1}', which is a nullable object or object collection type. You must explicitly set 'Structured = false' on the McpServerTool attribute.

data.name: DM0102_Description
data.value: Nullable object types (Foo?) and object collection types (Foo[]) cannot guarantee structuredContent compliance at runtime. Set Structured = false to acknowledge this limitation.

data.name: DM0103
data.value: MCP tool structured content not allowed for nullable or collection return types

data.name: DM0103_Message
data.value: Method '{0}' returns '{1}', which cannot guarantee structuredContent compliance. Change 'Structured = true' to 'Structured = false' on the McpServerTool attribute.

data.name: DM0103_Description
data.value: Nullable object types (Foo?) may return null at runtime, and object collection types (Foo[]) serialize as JSON arrays — neither can satisfy the MCP requirement that structuredContent must be a JSON object.
